# Microdot — Worldwide Microdata & Schema Web Development

## Who We Are
Microdot is a worldwide microdata and schema markup web development agency. We build lightning-fast HTML/CSS websites with native schema.org structured data, optimized for AI search engines (ChatGPT, Gemini, AI Overviews, Bing AI).

## What We Do
- **Microdata Integration** — Native schema.org markup embedded directly in HTML for maximum AI and search engine comprehension
- **Lightweight Engineering** — Zero framework bloat, pure HTML and CSS, perfect Core Web Vitals
- **AI Search Optimization** — Structured data designed for AI Overviews, knowledge panels, and semantic search
- **Semantic SEO** — Localized and global semantic SEO with proper entity relationship mapping
- **Performance Audits** — PageSpeed optimization and Core Web Vitals engineering

## Technical Stack
- Pure HTML5 with native schema.org microdata
- Lightweight CSS (no frameworks)
- Minimal vanilla JavaScript
- No CMS, no build tools, no framework bloat
- Static file deployment

## Structured Data Approach
We embed schema.org types (LocalBusiness, Service, WebPage, Organization, etc.) directly as inline microdata in HTML attributes — not JSON-LD in script tags. This ensures maximum compatibility with AI crawlers and search engine parsers.
